cd /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/lhrun2/runs/r2_main/samples/c0119837e5f5a0aa/a1/work/ws && python -c "
import parse

print('=== R1: letters format specifier ===')
# Should match only alphabetic characters
p = parse.Parser('{name:l}')
r = p.parse('hello')
print('parse(\"hello\") with {name:l}: ' + str(r))
assert r['name'] == 'hello', f'Expected \"hello\", got \"{r[\"name\"]}\"'

# Should NOT match digits
r2 = p.parse('123')
print('parse(\"123\") with {name:l}: ' + str(r2))
assert r2 is None, f'Expected None for numeric input, got {r2}'

# Should NOT match mixed alphanumeric
r3 = p.parse('hello123')
print('parse(\"hello123\") with {name:l}: ' + str(r3))
assert r3 is None, f'Expected None for mixed input, got {r3}'

# RepeatedNameError when same field used with different types
try:
    p4 = parse.Parser('{x:d} {x:l}')
    assert False, 'Should have raised RepeatedNameError'
except parse.RepeatedNameError:
    print('RepeatedNameError correctly raised for {x:d} {x:l}')

print()
print('=== R2: Result.__contains__ ===')
# Named fields
r = parse.parse('{name}', 'hello')
assert 'name' in r, 'key check failed'
assert 'hello' in r, 'value check failed'
assert 'z' not in r, 'non-existent should be False'

# Fixed fields
r = parse.parse('{}', 'world')
assert 0 in r, 'index check failed'
assert 'world' in r, 'fixed value check failed'
assert 'z' not in r, 'non-existent fixed value should be False'

# Mixed
r = parse.parse('{n} {}', 'x y')
assert 'n' in r, 'named key check failed'
assert 0 in r, 'fixed index check failed'
assert 'x' in r, 'named value check failed'
assert 'y' in r, 'fixed value check failed'

# Match object
p = parse.Parser('{w}')
m_obj = p._match_re.match('test')
if m_obj:
    mw = parse.Match(p, m_obj)
    assert 'w' in mw, 'Match key check failed'
    assert 'test' in mw, 'Match value check failed'

# search returns Result directly
r = parse.search('{n}', 'the number is 42')
assert r is not None
assert 'n' in r, 'search result key check failed'

print()
print('=== R3: Brace validation ===')
# Unmatched opening brace
for pattern in ['{name', 'hello {world', '{name:d} {n:d', 'a {b']:
    try:
        parse.Parser(pattern)
        assert False, f'Pattern \"{pattern}\" should raise ValueError'
    except ValueError as e:
        assert 'unmatched opening' in str(e).lower(), f'Wrong error message for \"{pattern}\": {e}'
        print(f'Pattern \"{pattern}\": OK (ValueError)')

# Unmatched closing brace
for pattern in ['test}', 'a b}']:
    try:
        parse.Parser(pattern)
        assert False, f'Pattern \"{pattern}\" should raise ValueError'
    except ValueError as e:
        assert 'unmatched closing' in str(e).lower(), f'Wrong error message for \"{pattern}\": {e}'
        print(f'Pattern \"{pattern}\": OK (ValueError)')

# Valid patterns
for pattern in ['{name}', '{name:d}', '{{literal}}', '{name:d}{other:s}', '{name:l}']:
    try:
        parse.Parser(pattern)
        print(f'Pattern \"{pattern}\": OK (valid)')
    except Exception as e:
        assert False, f'Pattern \"{pattern}\" should be valid but got: {e}'

print()
print('All tests passed!')
" 2>&1 | tail -40
